articles.title: 大型腹部手术患者个体化围术期血压管理：IMPROVE-multi随机临床试验
articles.originalTitle: Individualized Perioperative Blood Pressure Management in Patients Undergoing Major Abdominal Surgery: The IMPROVE-multi Randomized Clinical Trial.
articles.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Intraoperative hypotension is associated with organ injury. However, it remains unknown if targeted blood pressure management during surgery can improve clinical outcomes. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether individualized vs routine perioperative blood pressure management during major abdominal surgery improves clinical outcomes in patients considered at high risk of postoperative complications. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This randomized single-blind clinical trial enrolled patients 45 years or older undergoing elective major abdominal surgery with general anesthesia expected to last 90 minutes or longer who had at least 1 additional high-risk criterion between February 26, 2023, and April 25, 2024, at 15 German university hospitals. The date of last follow-up was July 25, 2024. INTERVENTION: Patients were randomized in a 1:1 ratio to individualized perioperative blood pressure management (with mean arterial pressure [MAP] targets based on preoperative mean nighttime MAP assessed using automated blood pressure monitoring) or routine blood pressure management with a MAP target of 65 mm Hg or higher. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was the incidence of a composite outcome of acute kidney injury, acute myocardial injury, nonfatal cardiac arrest, or death within the first 7 postoperative days. There were 22 secondary outcomes, including infectious complications within the first 7 postoperative days and a composite outcome of need for kidney replacement therapy, myocardial infarction, nonfatal cardiac arrest, or death within 90 days after surgery. RESULTS: Of the 1272 patients enrolled, 1142 were randomized (571 patients to each group), and 1134 were included in the primary analysis (median age, 66 years [IQR, 59-73 years]; 34.1% female). The primary outcome occurred in 190 of 567 patients (33.5%) assigned to individualized blood pressure management and 173 of 567 patients (30.5%) assigned to routine blood pressure management (relative risk, 1.10 [95% CI, 0.93-1.30]; P = .31). None of the 22 secondary outcomes were significantly different, including infectious complications within the first 7 postoperative days (90/567 [15.9%] vs 97/567 [17.1%]; P = .63) and a composite outcome of need for kidney replacement therapy, myocardial infarction, nonfatal cardiac arrest, or death within 90 days after surgery (32/566 [5.7%] vs 20/567 [3.5%]; P = .12). CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Among patients at high risk of postoperative complications undergoing major abdominal surgery, individualized perioperative blood pressure management with MAP targets based on preoperative mean nighttime MAP did not decrease the composite outcome of acute kidney injury, acute myocardial injury, nonfatal cardiac arrest, or death within the first 7 postoperative days compared with routine blood pressure management with a MAP target of 65 mm Hg or higher. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT05416944.

sections.heading: OBJECTIVE
sections.text: 评估在大型腹部手术中，个体化围手术期血压管理是否优于常规血压管理，以改善术后并发症高风险患者的临床结局。

sections.heading: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
sections.text: 这项随机单盲临床试验在2023年2月26日至2024年4月25日期间，于15家德国大学医院招募了45岁及以上、计划接受择期大型腹部手术、全身麻醉预计持续90分钟或以上且至少具有1项额外高风险标准的患者。最后一次随访日期为2024年7月25日。

sections.heading: INTERVENTION
sections.text: 患者按1:1比例随机分配至个体化围手术期血压管理组（平均动脉压[MAP]目标基于术前夜间平均MAP，通过自动血压监测评估）或常规血压管理组（MAP目标为65 mm Hg或更高）。

sections.heading: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
sections.text: 主要结局是术后前7天内急性肾损伤、急性心肌损伤、非致死性心脏骤停或死亡的复合结局的发生率。共有22个次要结局，包括术后前7天内的感染性并发症，以及术后90天内需要肾脏替代治疗、心肌梗死、非致死性心脏骤停或死亡的复合结局。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在入组的1272名患者中，1142名被随机分配（每组571名），1134名被纳入主要分析（中位年龄66岁[IQR，59-73岁]；34.1%为女性）。主要结局发生在个体化血压管理组的567名患者中的190名（33.5%）和常规血压管理组的567名患者中的173名（30.5%）（相对风险，1.10 [95% CI，0.93-1.30]；P = .31）。22个次要结局均无显著差异，包括术后前7天内的感染性并发症（90/567 [15.9%] vs 97/567 [17.1%]；P = .63）以及术后90天内需要肾脏替代治疗、心肌梗死、非致死性心脏骤停或死亡的复合结局（32/566 [5.7%] vs 20/567 [3.5%]；P = .12）。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
sections.text: 在接受大型腹部手术的术后并发症高风险患者中，与MAP目标为65 mm Hg或更高的常规血压管理相比，基于术前夜间平均MAP设定MAP目标的个体化围手术期血压管理并未降低术后前7天内急性肾损伤、急性心肌损伤、非致死性心脏骤停或死亡的复合结局。

articles.question: 围术期低血压与器官损伤相关，但既往缺乏高质量证据支持个体化血压目标能否改善临床结局。该多中心随机试验提供了直接证据，提示基于术前夜间MAP的个体化策略并未优于常规目标，对临床实践具有重要参考价值。
articles.conclusion: 在接受大型腹部手术的高危患者中，与常规血压管理（MAP≥65 mm Hg）相比，基于术前夜间平均MAP的个体化围术期血压管理并未降低术后7天内急性肾损伤、急性心肌损伤、非致死性心脏骤停或死亡的复合结局发生率。
articles.clinical: 对于接受大型腹部手术的高危患者，基于术前夜间MAP的个体化血压管理并未较常规MAP≥65 mm Hg带来额外临床获益，麻醉管理中无需常规采用该个体化策略。 术中血压管理仍应以避免低血压为目标，但具体目标值应结合患者个体情况，本研究不支持将术前夜间MAP作为常规目标设定依据。 由于主要结局为阴性，临床决策应关注其他证据支持的血压管理策略，如维持MAP≥65 mm Hg的常规做法。

articles.originalTitle: Mitochondria are absent from microglial processes performing surveillance, chemotaxis, and phagocytic engulfment.
articles.abstract: Microglia continually surveil the brain allowing for rapid detection of tissue damage or infection. Microglial metabolism is linked to tissue homeostasis, yet how mitochondria are subcellularly partitioned in microglia and dynamically reorganize during surveillance, injury responses, and phagocytic engulfment in the intact brain are not known. Here, we performed intravital imaging and ultrastructural analyses of microglia mitochondria in mice and human tissue, revealing that microglial processes diverge in their mitochondrial content, with some containing multiple mitochondria while others are completely void. Microtubules and hexokinase 2 mirror this uneven mitochondrial distribution indicating that these cytoskeletal and metabolic components are linked to mitochondrial organization in microglia. Microglial processes that engage in minute-to-minute surveillance typically do not have mitochondria. Moreover, unlike process surveillance, mitochondrial motility does not change with animal anesthesia. Likewise, the processes that acutely chemoattract to a lesion site or initially engage with a neuron undergoing programmed cell death do not contain mitochondria. Rather, microglia mitochondria have a delayed arrival into the responding cell processes. Thus, there is subcellular heterogeneity of mitochondrial partitioning. Moreover, microglial processes that surveil and acutely respond to damage do not contain mitochondria.

sections.text: 小胶质细胞持续监视大脑，以便快速检测组织损伤或感染。小胶质细胞的代谢与组织稳态相关，然而在完整大脑中，线粒体在小胶质细胞内的亚细胞分布以及它们在监视、损伤反应和吞噬性内吞过程中的动态重组尚不清楚。在此，我们对小鼠和人类组织中的小胶质细胞线粒体进行了活体成像和超微结构分析，揭示小胶质细胞突起在线粒体含量上存在差异，有些含有多个线粒体，而另一些则完全没有。微管和己糖激酶2反映了这种不均匀的线粒体分布，表明这些细胞骨架和代谢成分与小胶质细胞中的线粒体组织相关。参与每分钟监视的小胶质细胞突起通常没有线粒体。此外，与突起监视不同，线粒体运动不随动物麻醉而改变。同样，急性趋化至损伤部位或最初接触经历程序性细胞死亡的神经元的突起也不含线粒体。相反，小胶质细胞线粒体延迟到达反应性细胞突起中。因此，线粒体分布存在亚细胞异质性。此外，监视并急性响应损伤的小胶质细胞突起不含线粒体。

articles.originalTitle: Adenosine signalling drives antidepressant actions of ketamine and ECT.
articles.abstract: Ketamine and electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) achieve rapid remission in treatment-resistant depression. However, their mechanisms of action-the understanding of which is essential for refining therapeutic precision-remain unclear(1-3). Here, using mouse models, we identify adenosine signalling as a central pathway that underlies the antidepressant effects of these interventions. Results from genetically encoded adenosine sensor experiments and real-time optical recordings reveal that both therapies induce strong adenosine surges in key mood-regulatory regions, including the medial prefrontal cortex and the hippocampus. Genetic or pharmacological disruption of A(1) and A(2A) adenosine receptors abolishes their therapeutic effects, which establishes the essential role of adenosine signalling in antidepressant efficacy. Notably, adenosine signalling specifically in the medial prefrontal cortex drives antidepressant actions. Ketamine increases adenosine by modulating cellular metabolism to increase intracellular adenosine levels without causing neuronal hyperactivity. Leveraging this mechanism, we develop ketamine derivatives that enhance adenosine signalling and exhibit improved antidepressant efficacy with reduced side effects at therapeutic doses. Furthermore, acute intermittent hypoxia, a non-pharmacological intervention involving controlled reductions in oxygen levels, increases brain adenosine levels and produces antidepressant effects, paralleling the actions of ketamine and ECT. Our findings establish adenosine as a pivotal mediator of rapid-acting antidepressants and a tractable target for scalable, noninvasive therapeutics in major depressive disorder.

sections.text: 氯胺酮和电休克疗法（ECT）在难治性抑郁症中实现了快速缓解。然而，其作用机制——对于优化治疗精度至关重要——仍不清楚(1-3)。在此，我们利用小鼠模型，确定腺苷信号传导是这些干预措施抗抑郁作用的核心通路。基因编码的腺苷传感器实验和实时光学记录结果显示，这两种疗法在关键情绪调节区域（包括内侧前额叶皮层和海马）诱导强烈的腺苷激增。遗传或药理学破坏A(1)和A(2A)腺苷受体可消除其治疗效果，这确立了腺苷信号传导在抗抑郁疗效中的关键作用。值得注意的是，仅在内侧前额叶皮层中的腺苷信号传导即可驱动抗抑郁作用。氯胺酮通过调节细胞代谢来增加细胞内腺苷水平，从而增加腺苷，而不引起神经元过度活跃。利用这一机制，我们开发了增强腺苷信号传导的氯胺酮衍生物，在治疗剂量下表现出改善的抗抑郁疗效和减少的副作用。此外，急性间歇性低氧——一种涉及控制性降低氧水平的非药物干预——可增加大脑腺苷水平并产生抗抑郁效果，与氯胺酮和ECT的作用相似。我们的发现确立了腺苷作为快速起效抗抑郁药的关键介质，以及作为重度抑郁症中可扩展、非侵入性治疗的可操作靶点。

articles.originalTitle: Effect of naltrexone pretreatment on ketamine-induced glutamatergic activity and symptoms of depression: a randomized crossover study.
articles.abstract: We investigated the potential role of the opioid system in modulating glutamatergic effects of ketamine administration in major depressive disorder. Twenty-six adults with major depressive disorder participated in a double-blind crossover study, receiving oral placebo or 50 mg naltrexone before an intravenous infusion of 0.5 mg per kg ketamine. Brain glutamatergic activity in the anterior cingulate cortex was measured using functional magnetic resonance spectroscopy and depressive symptoms were assessed with the Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale. Naltrexone attenuated the increase in glutamate + glutamine to total N-acetylaspartate ratio during ketamine infusion compared to placebo (F(1,253) = 4.83, P = 0.029) and also attenuated the reduction in Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale scores on day 1 (condition-by-time interaction, F(1,74 )= 5.39, P = 0.023). These findings demonstrate that the opioid system modulates the acute response to ketamine and subsequent antidepressant effects. Interactions between the glutamate and opioid systems may have implications for the development of new depression treatment strategies. ClinicalTrials.gov registration: NCT04977674 .

sections.text: 我们研究了阿片系统在调节氯胺酮给药对重度抑郁症谷氨酸能效应中的潜在作用。26名患有重度抑郁症的成年人参加了一项双盲交叉研究，在静脉输注0.5 mg/kg氯胺酮前接受口服安慰剂或50 mg纳曲酮。使用功能性磁共振波谱测量前扣带回皮层的大脑谷氨酸能活性，并使用蒙哥马利-阿斯伯格抑郁评定量表评估抑郁症状。与安慰剂相比，纳曲酮减弱了氯胺酮输注期间谷氨酸+谷氨酰胺与总N-乙酰天冬氨酸比率的增加（F(1,253) = 4.83，P = 0.029），并且还减弱了第1天蒙哥马利-阿斯伯格抑郁评定量表评分的降低（条件-时间交互作用，F(1,74) = 5.39，P = 0.023）。这些发现表明，阿片系统调节对氯胺酮的急性反应和随后的抗抑郁效应。谷氨酸和阿片系统之间的相互作用可能对开发新的抑郁症治疗策略具有重要意义。ClinicalTrials.gov注册号：NCT04977674。

articles.title: 皮质脊髓疼痛敏感性特征：个体疼痛敏感性的预测标志物
articles.originalTitle: A corticospinal signature for interindividual pain sensitivity.
articles.abstract: Pain sensitivity variations represent a critical frontier in pain neuroscience, where advanced neuroimaging has mapped cerebral correlates of nociception for decades, yet conventional brain-centric models persistently overlook the spinal cord's hub role in pain gating and amplification. Here we show that a corticospinal pain sensitivity signature, a pattern of functional connectivity from simultaneous corticospinal magnetic resonance imaging, predicts individual pain sensitivity and clinical pain. Trained on resting-state data and validated across independent healthy (n = 723) and patient cohorts (n = 46), the model generalized to new datasets, distinguished pain from non-pain, and outperformed brain-centric models. Crucially, transcranial magnetic stimulation perturbation revealed a causal axis where enhanced motor cortex-spinal connectivity directly changes pain perception (r = 0.55). These results indicate a previously unknown corticospinal biomarker that bridges laboratory pain measures and patient symptoms, providing insights into translating pain mechanisms from healthy individuals to clinical populations and informing neuromodulation approaches.

sections.text: 疼痛敏感性的个体差异代表了疼痛神经科学的一个关键前沿，几十年来，先进的神经影像学已经绘制了伤害感受的大脑相关区域，然而传统的以大脑为中心的模型持续忽视了脊髓在疼痛门控和放大中的枢纽作用。在这里，我们展示了一种皮质脊髓疼痛敏感性特征，即同时进行的皮质脊髓磁共振成像的功能连接模式，可以预测个体疼痛敏感性和临床疼痛。该模型在静息态数据上训练，并在独立的健康（n = 723）和患者队列（n = 46）中验证，能够泛化到新数据集，区分疼痛与非疼痛，并优于以大脑为中心的模型。至关重要的是，经颅磁刺激扰动揭示了一个因果轴，其中增强的运动皮层-脊髓连接直接改变疼痛感知（r = 0.55）。这些结果表明，一种以前未知的皮质脊髓生物标志物连接了实验室疼痛测量和患者症状，为将疼痛机制从健康个体转化到临床人群提供了见解，并为神经调控方法提供了信息。

articles.question: 传统疼痛研究多聚焦于大脑，而脊髓在疼痛门控和放大中的关键作用常被忽视。该研究通过同时采集皮质和脊髓的MRI数据，构建了皮质脊髓疼痛敏感性特征，为理解疼痛机制和开发神经调控策略提供了新视角。
articles.conclusion: 基于静息态皮质脊髓功能连接构建的疼痛敏感性特征（CSps）可预测个体疼痛敏感性和临床疼痛，并在独立数据集中得到验证，提示其可能作为连接实验室疼痛测量与患者症状的皮质脊髓生物标志物。
articles.clinical: 该研究为疼痛敏感性个体差异提供了潜在的神经影像标志物，未来可能有助于麻醉前疼痛敏感性评估。 皮质脊髓通路可能成为神经调控（如TMS）的靶点，为慢性疼痛治疗提供新思路。 然而，当前证据尚不足以直接指导临床麻醉实践，需进一步验证。

articles.whyItMatters: 传统疼痛研究多聚焦于大脑，而脊髓在疼痛门控和放大中的关键作用常被忽视。该研究通过同时采集皮质和脊髓的MRI数据，构建了皮质脊髓疼痛敏感性特征，为理解疼痛机制和开发神经调控策略提供了新视角。
articles.background: 疼痛敏感性个体差异是疼痛神经科学的重要前沿。尽管先进神经影像已绘制了伤害感受的脑相关区域，但传统以脑为中心的模型常忽视脊髓在疼痛门控和放大中的枢纽作用。本研究旨在探索皮质脊髓功能连接模式能否预测个体疼痛敏感性及临床疼痛。
